_label: MOCK — test IdP users for acceptance scenario S5 (SPEC-04 §5). Every value is invented: `mock-`/`MOCK`/`モック` prefix, reserved `.test` domain (RFC 2606), no real person, institution, or e-mail. The only exception is eduPersonAffiliation, whose values must be real eduPerson vocabulary so the SP rule can be exercised (ADR-05 §3.5; allow-list in installer/tests/test_compose.py). Canonical copy; installer/grdm_dev/templates/idp/authsources.php.tmpl must agree per user and per attribute (checked by installer/tests/test_compose.py).

institution.entity_id_note: the IdP entityID is rendered from GRDM_PORT_TEST_IDP at compose render; see templates/idp/README.md

affiliation_vocabulary_exception.why: controlled vocabulary of eduPerson; `member` is what SP_REQUIRED_AFFILIATION tests, the others are the real companion values; no other attribute may carry a non-mock value (ADR-05 §3.5)

derived_identifiers.eduPersonTargetedID: not stored per user: core:TargetedID derives a persistent NameID from uid at login (ADR-05 §3.7)
derived_identifiers.pairwise-id: not stored per user: saml:PairwiseID derives hash(uid, SP)@idp.mock.test at login (ADR-05 §3.7)

attributes.jaDisplayName: モック 利用者（所属なし）

rejection_rule: shibboleth_sp requires eduPersonAffiliation to contain `member` (SP_REQUIRED_AFFILIATION); mock-user-noaff carries only `affiliate` and must stop at the SP 403 error page with no GRDM session.
